steps.name: before-unknown-account
steps.title: No account yet.
steps.text: The invoice already has an address. Asking the chain about it returns UNKNOWN_ACCOUNT.

steps.name: pay-tx-success
steps.title: One transaction pays and creates the account.
steps.text: The payer sends 1 NEAR. The same transaction creates the account and runs the payment.

steps.name: invoice-paid-after-callback
steps.title: The invoice reads PAID.
steps.text: After the payment callback, get_invoice on the new account returns PAID and the payer.

steps.name: split-merchant
steps.title: 92% to the merchant.
steps.text: The first of two transfers in the payment receipt.

steps.name: split-vault
steps.title: 8% to the tax vault.
steps.text: The invoice sets tax_bps to 800. That is 8%.

steps.name: transfer-path-uninitialized
steps.title: A wallet sends money to invoice B.
steps.text: A plain transfer to the address. The balance arrives and no contract is installed yet.

steps.name: sweep-tx-result
steps.title: A sweep settles invoice B.
steps.text: The sweep installs the contract and settles the same split. paid_by is null because sweep does not know who sent the money.
